name: Cluster Map
summary: Dense point locations grouped into themed cluster bubbles (count or summed value, ring split by category) that break apart as you zoom; spiderfy at max zoom.
summary_zh: 密集点位自动聚合为主题化的聚合气泡（显示数量或数值合计，外环按类别占比分段），缩放时逐级展开，最大缩放时蛛网展开重叠点。
description_zh: 适合门店、网点、工厂、客户等几十到几千个点位的分布展示，避免点相互遮挡。每行一个点（lat / lon）；相邻的点按屏幕距离聚合成气泡，中心数字是点数（或 clusterValue='sum' 时某个数值字段的合计），外环按类别占比着色。悬停聚合气泡显示按类别的数量/数值分解并勾出覆盖范围，点击放大展开；单个点悬停显示名称和格式化字段，点击或点击图例类别可交叉筛选。
best_for: Store / branch / site networks with dozens to thousands of points
Customer or asset locations where overlap hides density
Drill-down from regional totals to individual sites
avoid_when: Smooth density surfaces matter more than counts (use geo-heat)

label.desc: Point name (tooltip title, default click-to-filter field)

color.desc: Category for point colour, cluster ring segments and the clickable legend

value.desc: Numeric field summed in cluster tooltips (and shown in clusters with clusterValue = 'sum')

clusterRadius.desc: Pixel radius within which points merge

clusterValue.desc: count | sum — number shown in a cluster (sum of encode.value; bubble size follows it)

disableAt.desc: Zoom level from which points are never clustered

coverage.desc: Outline the area a cluster covers on hover

spiderfy.desc: Fan out overlapping points at max zoom

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

tooltip.desc: Extra fields listed in point tooltips

fit.desc: Initial view: 'data' | 'world' | [[south, west], [north, east]] | {center: [lat, lon], zoom}

legend.desc: Show the category legend and cluster key

filterField.desc: Field used for click-to-filter; defaults to encode.label

scrollZoom.desc: Mouse-wheel zoom: true | false | 'click' (armed after clicking the map)

interactions: Hover a cluster: breakdown by category + coverage outline
Click a cluster to zoom in; spiderfy at max zoom
Hover a point for its formatted fields
Click a point or legend category to cross-filter

samples.title: Floor area by cluster ('000 sq m) — summed values
